card.name: Linking words before radiation or chemotherapy
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, of, from, an opening parenthesis) right before a cancer treatment term such as radiation, radiotherapy, chemotherapy or anthracyclines. Seen in oncology label text about prior or combined treatment.

modes.label: with before a treatment
modes.description: The word with after treated, combination, or phase, leading into radiation or a chemotherapy drug.
modes.example: In childhood cancer survivors who were treated<< with>> radiation to the brain/head for their first

modes.label: of or from before radiation
modes.description: The word of or from after end, dose, or xerostomia, leading into radiotherapy or a cumulative dose.
modes.example: Beginning 4 weeks after the end<< of>> radiotherapy, administer TEMODAR orally

modes.label: Parenthesis after chemotherapy
modes.description: An opening parenthesis following a chemotherapy regimen name.

card.plain: It marks the small word just before a mention of radiation or chemotherapy in cancer drug labels.
